station.title: Set up a Yandex Station
station.description: The adapter connects to the station over SSH or ADB, keeps backups on the station and points it at itself. The station must be rooted. In 1–3 minutes it restarts and shows up in Home Assistant. If it does not come back, the changes are rolled back.

data_description.password: SSH only. Empty means an empty root password, as on most rooted stations.
data_description.allow_untested: Only Yandex Station Midi and Lite 2 have been tested. Other models may misbehave.

error.auth_failed: The station rejected the login. Check the username, password or key.
error.unsupported: This station model is untested. Enable “Allow an untested model” to try anyway.
error.timeout: The station did not connect to the adapter within 4 minutes. Its settings were rolled back.
error.station_error: A command on the station failed. See the Quasar Adapter app log.
error.busy: The adapter is setting up another station. Wait and retry.
error.no_backup: The station has no backup of the factory quasar.cfg (/data/quasar.cfg.orig).
error.unknown: Unknown error. See the Quasar Adapter app log.
error.station_unreachable: Could not connect to the station. Check the IP, port and method.
